back_translation: O sons of Benjamin, flee for safety out of Jerusalem! Blow the ram's horn in Tekoa; raise a fire-signal over Beth-haccherem, for disaster is looming from the north, a great destruction.
The Daughter of Zion, though beautiful and delicate, I will destroy.
Shepherds and their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents all around her, each one grazing his own portion.
'Prepare war against her; rise up, let us attack at noon! Woe to us, for the day is nearly over, and the evening shadows are lengthening.'
'Rise up, let us attack by night and destroy her fortresses!'
For the LORD of Hosts says this: 'Cut down trees and build a siege ramp around Jerusalem. This is the city that must be punished; there is nothing but oppression within her.'
As a well keeps its water fresh, so she keeps her evil fresh. The sound of violence and ruin is heard in her; sickness and wounds are continually before Me.
Take warning, O Jerusalem, lest My soul turn away from you in revulsion, and lest I make you a desolation, a land without inhabitant.
The LORD of Hosts says this: 'Glean the remnant of Israel clean, as one gleans a vine. Pass your hand back again like a grape-gatherer over the branches.'

To whom can I speak and warn, that they will listen? Behold, their ears are stopped, so they cannot heed. Behold, the word of the LORD has become a thing of scorn to them; they take no pleasure in it.

But I am full of the wrath of the LORD; I am weary of holding it in. 'Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the gathering of young men together. For both husband and wife will be captured, the old and the very aged.'
Their houses will be turned over to others, their fields and wives as well, for I will stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land, declares the LORD.
For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for unjust gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
They heal the wound of My people superficially, saying, 'Peace, peace,' when there is no peace at all.

They ought to be ashamed of the abomination they committed, but they are not ashamed at all; they do not even know how to blush. Therefore they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse, says the LORD.

The LORD says this: 'Stand at the crossroads and look; ask for the ancient paths, where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find a resting place for your souls.' But they said, 'We will not walk in it.'
I appointed watchmen over you, saying, 'Listen for the sound of the ram's horn.' But they said, 'We will not listen.'
Therefore hear, O nations, and know, O assembly, what will happen to them.
Hear, O earth! Behold, I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their own schemes, because they did not heed My words and rejected My instruction.
What does frankincense from Sheba mean to Me, or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices do not please Me.
Therefore the LORD says this: 'Behold, I will place stumbling blocks before this people; fathers and sons alike will stumble over them; neighbor and friend will perish.'
The LORD says this: 'Behold, a people is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is being stirred up from the ends of the earth.'
They grasp bow and spear; they are cruel and show no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, drawn up like men for battle against you, O Daughter of Zion.
We have heard the report of them; our hands hang limp. Anguish has seized us, pain like that of a woman in labor.
Do not go out into the field, and do not walk on the road, for the enemy has a sword; there is terror on every side.
O daughter of my people, gird yourself with sackcloth and roll in ashes. Mourn bitterly as for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
I have made you an assayer of metal among My people, and a fortress, so that you may know and test their ways.
They are all the most stubborn rebels, going about as slanderers; they are bronze and iron; all of them are corrupt.
The bellows blow fiercely, so that the lead is consumed by the fire, but the refining is in vain, for the wicked are not separated out.
People will call them 'rejected silver,' because the LORD has rejected them.
